newsitem.title: USA: Calif. gov unveils plan to overhaul welfare.
newsitem.headline: Calif. gov unveils plan to overhaul welfare.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson will propose later Thursday a sweeping welfare reform plan that would end the state mandate that counties provide general assistance to the poor, his spokesman said.

The proposal would allow California counties to reduce or even eliminate their general assistance programs, which provide a minimum level of support, typically to single adult males who do not qualify for other types of assistance.
Counties could use these funds for other programs, such as for job training, Wilson spokesman Sean Walsh said.
